head_commit.message:
Stabilize CSP Graph equivalence and production validation

Validated source/build/Graph/CSP hardening. Removes approved legacy inline style attributes at build time, keeps multilingual presentation in CSS, synchronizes the strict CSP hash, preserves exact Turtle coordinates and JSON-LD/Turtle equivalence, and strengthens deterministic source-to-live validation.
